name: inprocess-obi-apb-ibex-timer-overflow-baseline-fuzz
notes: A/B baseline for configs/scenarios/inprocess-obi-apb-ibex-timer-compare-f5-fuzz.json: the CPU, the DMA, the windows, the F1 program length and the bounded wait are identical; only the declared F5 source facts differ, and here they are the pre-existing timer0 overflow file configs/behaviors/pulp_timer_f5.json (irq_o[0], 16 ticks, [[4,0],[8,0],[0,4294967295]], status TIMER0_COUNT offset 0)

the scenario states no inline F5 facts: the entry merges the behavior file's facts into the declaration before f5_declaration/pin_declaration, so a file-only scenario is the same path main() already takes
the timer declares 50 MHz, the CPU 50 MHz and the ZipDMA a nominal 1 Hz simulation rate, so assume_single_clock states that one host tick drives all three models
f1_program_words 4 and handler_wait_iterations 128 match the compare scenario so the two batches differ only in the declared IRQ source
two IRQ sources are declared for one CPU input: the target's pulse on irq_o[0] and the ZipDMA completion level; the entry wires both links and numbers the DMA one after the target
